narrative.title: The Relay Bidding Ladder
narrative.scenario: The same relay network now charges per hop, so the courier wants the minimum number of relays to reach the final post. Dispatch proceeds in waves: within the current wave's reachable band, scout the farthest post any member can open up; when the band is exhausted, that scout becomes the next wave's frontier and the hop counter rises by one.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums where nums[i] is the maximum hop length from index i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum number of hops needed to reach the last index.
constraints: The last index is always reachable

testCases.explanation: One hop reaches index 1, whose 3-hop range lands on the last index.
A different second hop (through index 1 to index 4) still needs only two waves.

hintLevels: Level 1: Minimum hops is a level count — BFS in disguise over an implicit graph.
Level 2: Sweep a wave: everything between `end` and the frontier belongs to the current level; `farthest` previews the next.
Level 3: When the sweep index hits `end`, close the wave and open the next at `farthest` — the early return handles the last leap.
